theModel.label: THE EXPANSION MODEL
theModel.title: Circle to Library to Campus.
theModel.lead: We do not open empty commercial campuses. Each centre begins as an agile study circle in a partner space, grows into a community library, and expands into a full campus only when local demand is proven.

stages.name: Stage 01: Circle
stages.summary: An initial small-group classroom pod in a partner space, running daily classes, entrance baselines, and peer teaching.
stages.requirement: Requires a verified local guide, classroom space, and active student demand.

stages.name: Stage 02: Library
stages.summary: Adding the quiet Knowledge Commons floor when enough local readers register and purchase reader cards.
stages.requirement: Requires dedicated quiet desks, reference collections, and cardholder subscriptions.

stages.name: Stage 03: Campus
stages.summary: A complete three-floor gurukul: Learning Commons on Floor G, Knowledge Commons on Floor 1, and Venture Hub on Floor 2.
stages.requirement: Requires sustainable operating revenue and resident builders who teach children.

districtFirst.label: LOCAL ROOTS
districtFirst.title: Rooted in district ecology.
districtFirst.lead: Each district has its own crafts, ecology, and technical requirements. Rather than forcing a generic curriculum, future centres will specialize in their district's core strengths.
districtFirst.chambaOpenStatus: Chamba's specialisation is open: we are currently determining whether Chamba's primary focus should be mountain hydrology, timber craft engineering, or computational linguistics.
districtFirst.onlyChambaRule: Chamba is our only centre today. We do not announce or promise centres in any other district until the Chamba classroom is fully proven.
